=Create an executive weekly business report based on this data:

{{ JSON.stringify($json, null, 2) }}

Structure the report with:
1. Executive Summary (2-3 sentences)
2. Key Wins This Week
3. Areas of Concern
4. Week-over-Week Trends
5. Recommended Focus Areas for Next Week
6. Resource Allocation Recommendations

Use clear, concise language suitable for C-level executives.
